title: Blake Stone: Aliens of Gold & Planet Strike

note.windows: The first build takes about 10 minutes and under 1 GB. Python, CMake, Git and the Visual Studio Build Tools (about 2 GB) are installed if they are missing. Point it at either game; it finds the other in your Steam library.
note.darwin: The first build takes about 10 minutes. It needs Homebrew and Xcode's command line tools, and installs CMake and SDL2 with Homebrew. Point it at either game; it finds the other in the same folder or your Steam library.
note.default: The first build takes a few minutes. It needs gcc, CMake, Python 3, git and SDL2's development files from your package manager; if any are missing it says which, with the command to install them. Point it at either game; it finds the other in the same folder or your Steam library.
